name: vbapm
description: A package manager and build tool for VBA

scripts.dev: run-s deps typecheck format:check test build:cli
scripts.clean: rimraf lib && rimraf dist && rimraf addins/build

json-comments.tips: You may install the JsonComments plugin to enable commenting functionality for JSON files, see: https://github.com/zhangfisher/json_comments_extension

package.json.scripts.format: Formats all .ts and .js files using Prettier
package.json.scripts.format:check: Checks all .ts and .js files with Prettier
package.json.scripts.test: Runs Jest tests in a single thread
package.json.scripts.typecheck: Runs the TypeScript compiler to check for type errors
package.json.scripts.test:e2e: Runs end-to-end tests using a specific Jest configuration
package.json.scripts.build:lib: Core build: rollup bundle + .d.ts generation (used by both npm and standalone channels)
package.json.scripts.build:cli: Standalone CLI build: rollup bundle (no sourcemaps, no .d.ts) + fetch vendored Node binary
package.json.scripts.build:dev: Allows to quickly rebuild the project in development mode with environment variables set for easier debugging of the js/ts code
package.json.scripts.build:addins: Builds the add-ins by running a custom build script in the addins directory
package.json.scripts.build:bootstrap: Update the bootstrap file (used to build the addin) by using the latest addin build (inception!)
package.json.scripts.clean: Removes generated files from lib, dist, and addins/build directories
package.json.devDependencies.cross-env: Used to set environment variables in a cross-platform-compatible way for build scripts
package.json.jest.transformIgnorePatterns: @decimalturn/toml-patch v1+ is ESM-only. Jest (running in CJS mode via ts-jest) skips transforming node_modules by default, which causes 'Unexpected token export' errors. This pattern excludes toml-patch from that skip list so ts-jest can downcompile it to CJS at test time.
package.json.jest.transform: Required alongside transformIgnorePatterns: overrides the default ts-jest transform to add allowJs:true so ts-jest can process the plain .js ESM dist file of @decimalturn/toml-patch.
package.json.overrides: Pins vulnerable transitive dependencies to patched versions to remove critical npm audit findings without large upstream upgrades.
package.json.overrides.minimist: Prototype pollution fix, mainly needed for ts-jest/handlebars transitive chain.
package.json.overrides.underscore: Arbitrary code execution mitigation, mainly needed for logic-solver transitive dependency.
package.json.overrides.shell-quote: Command injection advisory mitigation, mainly needed for npm-run-all transitive dependency.
